wallpapers.name: Golden Spire
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: A lone figure on a rain-slick rooftop above a megacity at night: flying cars cross between the towers, lightning flickers in the clouds, the golden spire pulses with light and rain ripples across the roof.

wallpapers.name: Holo District
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: A figure on a wet rooftop above a city of giant holograms: the holo screens flicker and glitch, the tower beam pulses, searchlights sweep the clouds and flying cars hover and stream past in the rain.

wallpapers.name: Rainglass
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: Rain on a capsule-apartment window: the neon city melts into bokeh behind the fogged glass, every drop a tiny lens bringing it back into focus, as a skytrain glides past.

wallpapers.name: Aurora
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: Northern lights ripple over the mountains and reflect in a still lake.

wallpapers.name: Earth Orbit
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: Earth turns slowly beneath the station, with city lights on the night side and the thin blue line of the atmosphere along the horizon.

wallpapers.name: Hover Run
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: A rider on a hover bike skims an endless ocean at sunset, trailing neon light, spray and a foaming wake.

wallpapers.name: Lava Lamp
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: Warm wax blobs that drift, merge and split.

wallpapers.name: Megacity
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: A cyberpunk skyline at night: towers fading into neon haze, flickering billboards, streams of flying cars and a holographic koi drifting between the spires.

wallpapers.name: Neon Alley
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: A rain-soaked cyberpunk street at night: buzzing blade signs, sagging cables, rising steam and neon smeared across the wet ground.

wallpapers.name: Neon Grid
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: A retro synthwave horizon: striped sun, twinkling stars and an endless neon grid.

wallpapers.name: Space Elevator
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: Twilight over the ocean: a tether rises from an offshore anchor station into the stars, still catching the sun high above, as climber pods ride it to orbit.

wallpapers.name: Warp Drive
wallpapers.author: Prux Tech
wallpapers.description: The view from the cockpit in hyperspace: stars stretch into streaks, plasma swirls around the tunnel and shock rings roll past a softly glowing HUD.
